sentence: You can download the app for free from the store
explanation: 'Download' significa transferir datos desde internet a un dispositivo.

sentence: My phone battery dies very quickly these days
explanation: 'These days' se usa para hablar de una tendencia reciente.

sentence: She spends too much time scrolling through social media
explanation: 'Spend time' se combina con el gerundio para describir cómo se usa el tiempo.

sentence: The website crashed because too many people were online
explanation: 'Because' introduce la razón por la que la página web falló.

sentence: I forgot to charge my laptop last night
explanation: 'Forget to do something' significa olvidar hacer algo que era necesario.

sentence: Could you send me the file by email, please
explanation: 'Could you...?' es una forma educada de pedir algo.

sentence: The company launched a new streaming service last month
hint: Subject + past verb + object + time expression
explanation: 'Launch' significa lanzar o presentar un nuevo producto al público.

sentence: You should back up your photos before you update the software
explanation: 'Back up' significa hacer una copia de seguridad de los datos.

sentence: My internet connection has been very slow recently
explanation: El presente perfecto describe una situación que empezó en el pasado y continúa ahora.

sentence: They are developing an app that helps people learn languages
explanation: 'That' introduce una cláusula relativa que describe la aplicación.
